title: Bind the Commons Lang reversal theorem to loaded release methods
description: Check the descending and ascending cursors of Commons Lang 3.17.0 ArrayUtils.reverse on its byte-bound two-cursor model. Extract the two resolved Math helpers from Temurin 21, specialize the valid-range Lean proof, and corroborate its mirror and frame through an alias on the original JVM. Check the unrestricted signed-bounds counterexample separately.
expected: Lean checks the valid range model over the loaded bytes and records its axioms. The JVM produces 40525 normal observations and 3640 exact exceptions.

steps.name: Check the pinned release, Lean theorem and physical JVM grid
